notes.title: Online server maintenance
notes.content:
http://milestone.it/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/thumb-steam.jpg

Hey Top Riders!

Milestone informs that from Monday 16th November 2015 – 18.00 GMT+1 – till Tuesday 17th November 2015 – 19.00 GMT+1 – the PC/STEAM™ online servers of RIDE will be down for maintenance. This update will improve online stability and performance to all the players.

Thanks for the understanding,

Continue to follow us on: 

-  Facebook  
-  Official Youtube Channel 
-  Twitter   hashtag #ridevideogame 
-  Official Website 

Milestone Team

notes.title: RIDE - Patch #2
notes.content:
http://i58.tinypic.com/4vphms.jpg

Dear Gamers,

We apologize for the issues you were facing in the last weeks, we’re now happy to inform you that we’ve just released a patch to solve them.

You can find below the changelog:

- Vast number of fixes on 3D Bikes: custom parts, textures, materials.
- Physics tweaking on three bikes: Honda RC30, Honda RC45 and Yamaha FZR750 OW01.
- Added the option to replay intro movies of bike categories.
- Online starting grid menu no more remains during race.
- Visual and physics tweaking for many DLC bikes.
- Online stability improvements.
- Various minor fixes.

Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the Bug Thread

Continue to follow us on: 

-  Facebook  
-  Official Youtube Channel 
-  Twitter   hashtag #ridevideogame 
-  Official Website 

Milestone Team

notes.title: RIDE with the Yamaha DLC's!
notes.content:
Hi Gamers,

Extend your riding experience with one of the most iconic bike manufacturer in the world: Yamaha!

There are two DLC's: which one will you choose?


Yamaha Historical Bikes a memento of the recent past, featuring bikes that enchanted millions of motorcyclists:
[olist]
Yamaha YZF R7 (1998) 
Yamaha YZF R1 (1998
Yamaha YZF R1 (2002)
[/olist]

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/347450/ss_605ca313a66c0bfce23f4049267815d7586bdbd6.1920x1080.jpg?t=1427794739

Yamaha 2015 Bike Models the apex of Yamaha technology: 
[olist]
Yamaha R1 (2015)
Yamaha R1M (2015)
Yamaha R6 (2015)
[/olist]

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/345900/ss_5e7b452d59b3fdeabfe682509550bb9d7b5b87ac.600x338.jpg?t=1427794727


The motorcycle revolution is on the starting grid
The revolution is RIDE

notes.title: RIDE - Patch
notes.content:
https://scontent-mxp.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/v/t1.0-9/10354658_1593466740923071_2397150126791769392_n.jpg?oh=f9427677f48eadf4183e0ea8878dba37&oe=55BD24A9

Dear Gamers,

 we apologize for the issue you were facing in this days, we're happy to inform you that we've yet release a patch to solve the crashes and savegame corruption.

If the savegames were corrupted you have to delete them and restart the game

We hope you'll enjoy to RIDE back on the World Tour!

 Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the Bug Thread

Thank you for your understanding.

Milestone Team

notes.title: RIDE - Demo
notes.content:
Hi gamers!

RIDE Demo is now available!

http://ridevideogame.com/wp-content/uploads/thumb-Demo-Ride.jpg

Take a look at the trailer and start the race! 

The contents of the RIDE Demo are the following:

Quick Race game mode
1 Country Track (Sierra Nevada)
1 Naked Heavyweight bike
1 Superbike
1 Supersport bike

Plus, some of the customizable elements will be available for you. Start to discover the infinite potential of RIDE Customization!

Enjoy RIDE!

Follow us on the Official Facebook page, and follow the Tweets on @MilestoneItaly


Milestone Team
